title: Epic Games reportedly pivoting to "AI first" game development model
script:
Epic Games is pivoting to an AI-first development model for its delayed Marvel and Star Wars shooter.
Chief executive Tim Sweeney mandated generative tools after development fell behind schedule.
Staff are relying on models like Anthropic Claude to write code instead of traditional manual programming.
Human developers now guide and supervise the output rather than typing out every line.
The Disney collaboration project aims to finish production faster using this workflow.
Would you play a major shooter built mostly with generative tools?
